name: expert-query-etl
description: The ‘Expert Query’ ETL application is used to load data from ATTAINS (Oracle) into the ‘Expert Query’ Postgres DB.
author: USEPA (https://www.epa.gov)

scripts.etl_all: cross-env DOTENV_PATH=./.env.local npx dotenv run -- node --inspect app/tasks/etlAll.js
scripts.etl_database: cross-env DOTENV_PATH=./.env.local npx dotenv run -- node --inspect app/tasks/etlDatabase.js
scripts.etl_domain_values: cross-env DOTENV_PATH=./.env.local npx dotenv run -- node --inspect app/tasks/etlDomainValues.js
scripts.etl_glossary: cross-env DOTENV_PATH=./.env.local npx dotenv run -- node --inspect app/tasks/etlGlossary.js
scripts.start_local_cmd: cross-env DOTENV_PATH=./.env.local npx dotenv run -- nodemon --ignore 'app/tests' --inspect app/index.js
